description: Fix a syntax error in a complex ETL SQL script that joins multiple tables for sales reporting.
buggy_sql:
SELECT t1.region, t2.product_name, SUM(t3.amount) as total_sales
FROM sales.transactions t1
JOIN products.catalog t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.id
LEFT JOIN finance.revenue t3 ON t1.transaction_id = t3.transaction_id
WHERE t1.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY t1.region, t2.product_name
HAVING SUM(t3.amount) > 10000
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT region, product_name, total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as rank
  FROM (
    SELECT t1.region, t2.product_name, SUM(t3.amount) as total_sales
    FROM sales.transactions t1
    JOIN products.catalog t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.id
    LEFT JOIN finance.revenue t3 ON t1.transaction_id = t3.transaction_id
    WHERE t1.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
    GROUP BY t1.region, t2.product_name
    HAVING SUM(t3.amount) > 10000
  ) ranked_sales
  WHERE rank <= 5
) top_sales_by_region
ORDER BY region, total_sales DESC;
fixed_sql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT region, product_name, total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as rank
  FROM (
    SELECT t1.region, t2.product_name, SUM(t3.amount) as total_sales
    FROM sales.transactions t1
    JOIN products.catalog t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.id
    LEFT JOIN finance.revenue t3 ON t1.transaction_id = t3.transaction_id
    WHERE t1.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
    GROUP BY t1.region, t2.product_name
    HAVING SUM(t3.amount) > 10000
  ) ranked_sales
  WHERE rank <= 5
) top_sales_by_region
ORDER BY region, total_sales DESC;
error_message: ERROR: syntax error at or near SELECT at line 12

description: Fix a missing comma in a multi-table join for customer segmentation.
buggy_sql:
WITH customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    c.segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count,
    SUM(o.total_amount) as lifetime_value
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  lifetime_value,
  NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC) as value_quartile

fixed_sql:

description: Fix a semantic error where revenue calculation double-counts due to join multiplication.
buggy_sql:
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as total_orders,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) as total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
fixed_sql:
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as total_orders,
  o_agg.total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(order_total) as total_spent
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) o_agg ON c.customer_id = o_agg.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, o_agg.total_spent
ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
error_message: total_spent is inflated because SUM over a join multiplies order totals by the number of items per order

description: Fix a semantic error where the query counts orders instead of unique products sold per region.
buggy_sql:
SELECT
  r.region_name,
  p.product_category,
  COUNT(o.order_id) as products_sold,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) as revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY r.region_name, p.product_category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
fixed_sql:
SELECT
  r.region_name,
  p.product_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) as products_sold,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) as revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY r.region_name, p.product_category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
error_message: products_sold counts order line items instead of unique products

description: Fix a semantic error where division by zero is possible in revenue per customer calculation.
buggy_sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) as month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as monthly_orders,
  SUM(order_total) as monthly_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(order_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 2) as revenue_per_customer
FROM orders
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)
ORDER BY month DESC;
fixed_sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) as month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as monthly_orders,
  SUM(order_total) as monthly_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(order_total) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 0), 2) as revenue_per_customer
FROM orders
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)
ORDER BY month DESC;
error_message: Division by zero possible when no customers in a month

description: Fix a semantic error where growth rate calculation does not handle NULL or zero previous month revenue.
buggy_sql:
WITH monthly_stats AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) as month,
    SUM(order_total) as revenue
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)
)
SELECT
  curr.month,
  curr.revenue as current_revenue,
  ROUND((curr.revenue - prev.revenue) / prev.revenue * 100, 2) as growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_stats curr
LEFT JOIN monthly_stats prev ON curr.month = DATEADD(month, 1, prev.month)
ORDER BY curr.month ASC;
fixed_sql:
WITH monthly_stats AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) as month,
    SUM(order_total) as revenue
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)
)
SELECT
  curr.month,
  curr.revenue as current_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN prev.revenue IS NULL OR prev.revenue = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((curr.revenue - prev.revenue) / prev.revenue * 100, 2)
  END as growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_stats curr
LEFT JOIN monthly_stats prev ON curr.month = DATEADD(month, 1, prev.month)
ORDER BY curr.month ASC;
error_message: Growth rate calculation does not handle NULL or zero revenue from previous month

description: Fix a semantic error where window function scope incorrectly partitions the running total.
buggy_sql:
SELECT
  employee_id,
  employee_name,
  department,
  salary,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC) as dept_salary_rank,
  SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY hire_date) as running_dept_salary
FROM employees
WHERE employment_status = 'Active'
ORDER BY department, salary DESC;
fixed_sql:
SELECT
  employee_id,
  employee_name,
  department,
  salary,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC) as dept_salary_rank,
  SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY hire_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as running_dept_salary
FROM employees
WHERE employment_status = 'Active'
ORDER BY department, salary DESC;
error_message: SUM window without ROWS clause gives wrong running total; RANK creates gaps with ties
